target.user-input: editing by the links: each operation on the plane is one edit of the tree, the way back writes the source, and the engine reads it again before the picture changes

instruction.user-input: build the operations of the signed table, each as one edit of the tree: connect two nodes by a connector of a chosen type, change the type of a connector, move the end of a connector to another node, cut a connector, place a command from the palette of icons, remove a node, change the order of siblings, write the operand of a node, and wrap nodes in a section, a block or a part
offer on each connector the types the two ends admit, and name the operator each one writes: nest, chain, item, sequence, reference and result

requirement.user-input: an edit the tree cannot hold is refused by name before it is applied, and the plane and the source stay as they were
every edit is undone and redone, and the source after undo is the bytes it was
what an edit raises is shown where it lands: a new fix, ask or note appears on its node as soon as the engine has read the source again

constraint.user-input: the plane never writes source by itself: it edits the tree, the way back writes, and the parse of what was written is what the plane shows next
nothing vanishes in silence: a node cut from its only connector stays in the package as a root command, and removing a node that holds others asks first what happens to them

never.user-input: an edit that changes the meaning of a command the user did not touch

validate.user-input: each operation of the signed table has a case: the source it writes is the source a hand would write for that tree, the engine reads it with no new fix, and the tree read back is the edited tree
each edit the table refuses is refused by its name and leaves the bytes of the source untouched, each seen failing before it counts
over the declared sources, every connector cut and connected again by the same type gives the source back byte for byte
